column1: # benchmark/cases.tsv — agent-savings case matrix (Wave 0, D2 design)
# 6 archetypes x 8 languages = 48 cases over real cold-clonable repos.
#   locate   "where is X defined"          CW: query        | BL: grep def + read 1 file
#   callers  "what calls X"                CW: callers      | BL: grep usages + read N files
#   callees  "what does X call"            CW: callees      | BL: read X's body + grep
#   feature  "how does <feature> work"     CW: context (x3) | BL: grep feature regex + read N files
#   impl     "implementers/subtypes of X"  CW: impact       | BL: grep interface + read N impl files
#   blast    "what breaks if X changes"    CW: impact       | BL: grep symbol + read N dependant files
#   lang  repo  archetype  symbol  feature_query  baseline_regex  oracle_anchors
# - symbol         : the named symbol the CW tool is invoked with (and grep baseline targets)
# - feature_query  : NL task for the `feature` archetype's `context` call (empty otherwise)
# - baseline_regex : the grep -E pattern the baseline agent would run for this task
# - oracle_anchors : '|'-joined anchor symbol names for the `feature` archetype oracle
#                    (empty for other archetypes; their oracle is derived from the graph)
